summary: Full E2E frontend regression of the new /midnight-relay page. All acceptance criteria pass: page renders with all sections, multiaddr + peer-id + snippet clipboard copies work and toast, tab switching swaps snippets, FAQ accordion single-open with first-open-by-default works, cross-page hash nav returns to home /#framework, SPA nav from home to relay works, language toggle updates nav labels, footer Midnight Relay link navigates via SPA, CTA buttons (mailto info@micells.io with subject, docs link target=_blank to https://docs.midnight.network/, copy multiaddr) all correct, mobile viewport (390x844) renders hero/map/tabs/FAQ/mobile-nav-relay link.

issues: Tabs row (Bash / Config File / Docker) plus right-side Copy button is a bit tight at 390px; Copy button visually pushed to edge though still clickable. Consider wrapping or moving Copy button below tabs on mobile.

critical_code_review_comments: Nav.jsx: On non-home routes scrolled state is forced via useEffect but the transparent bg-transparent momentarily flashes before hydration. Consider initialising useState(!isHome) so initial paint on /midnight-relay directly renders white nav. Minor.
RelayHero.jsx: navigator.clipboard is used without a fallback for non-secure contexts; acceptable since prod is HTTPS.
MidnightRelay.jsx uses document.title in useEffect only, which is fine for SPA; consider adding <Helmet> or meta description for SEO in future.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Midnight Relay page /midnight-relay is fully functional. All data-testids in the request map exist and behave correctly. Console shows only a benign React 'fetchpriority vs fetchPriority' warning unrelated to this feature. Backend endpoints not touched. Home page register/register-interest flow was not re-tested (previous iteration_2 covered EOI green).
